en.headline: Housing Society fined HK$8,000 over faulty fire alarm after fatal blaze
en.dek: The Hong Kong Housing Society pleaded guilty at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Court to failing to keep fire service installations in working order at Lotus Tower, where a man died in an October 2025 fire.
body: The Hong Kong Housing Society was fined HK$8,000 on Friday after pleading guilty to one count of failing to keep a fire service installation in efficient working order.

The case at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Court concerned a faulty fire alarm at Lotus Tower in Kwun Tong Garden Estate. A 52-year-old man died in a fire at the estate on 30 October last year. Firefighters found the alarm did not sound even after the glass of a manual call point was broken.
Prosecutors said a loose wire caused the fault. The Housing Society, Hong Kong’s second-largest public housing provider, admitted the summons.
The fine was imposed following the guilty plea entered on Friday.

zh.headline: 房協火警警報故障罰款8000元 涉觀塘致命火警
zh.dek: 香港房屋協會於觀塘裁判法院承認一項未有保持消防裝置有效運作的控罪，該案涉及蓮花樓火警警報故障，去年10月有一名男子在火災中死亡。
body: 香港房屋協會星期五承認一項未有保持消防裝置有效運作的控罪，被判罰款8000元。
案件在觀塘裁判法院審理，涉及觀塘花園大廈蓮花樓的火警警報故障。去年10月30日該屋邨發生火警，一名52歲男子死亡。消防人員發現即使打破手動報警按鈕的玻璃，警報仍未響動。
控方指故障由一條鬆脫電線引起。作為本港第二大公營房屋機構，房協承認傳票指控。
罰款於星期五認罪後判處。
